entities.name: Whole body
entities.summary: 70 kg reference adult. Total body water about 42 L: about 14 L extracellular (plasma plus interstitial fluid) and 28 L intracellular.

entities.name: Cardiovascular system
entities.summary: Heart and blood vessels. Sets arterial pressure, which drives glomerular filtration and pressure natriuresis; atrial stretch releases ANP.

entities.name: Renal and urinary system
entities.summary: Kidneys, ureters and bladder. Filters plasma and adjusts water and electrolyte excretion to match intake.

entities.name: Digestive system
entities.summary: Gut and accessory organs. Absorbs ingested water and sodium; the liver secretes angiotensinogen.

entities.name: Endocrine system
entities.summary: Hormone-secreting glands. In V1: posterior pituitary (vasopressin), adrenal cortex (aldosterone), and cardiac atria (ANP, endocrine function of the heart).

entities.name: Nervous system
entities.summary: Brain and nerves. In V1: osmoreceptors in the lamina terminalis and hypothalamus, and the thirst circuit.

entities.name: Musculoskeletal system
entities.summary: Bones and skeletal muscle. In V1, skeletal muscle stands in for the intracellular fluid compartment, which it dominates by volume.

entities.name: Integumentary system
entities.summary: Skin and appendages. Route of insensible and sweat water loss; interstitial sodium storage is reported but not modelled in V1.

entities.name: Respiratory system
entities.summary: Airways and lungs. In V1 only as a site of angiotensin-converting enzyme and of respiratory insensible water loss.

entities.name: Heart
entities.summary: Pumps about 5 L/min at rest. In this model mean arterial pressure follows ECF volume; the badge on the heart shows the simulated MAP.

entities.name: Aorta
entities.summary: Main artery leaving the left ventricle. Its pressure drives glomerular filtration in the kidneys.

entities.name: Venae cavae
entities.summary: Large veins returning blood to the right atrium. Atrial stretch releases ANP when ECF volume expands.

entities.name: Kidneys
entities.summary: Filter about 180 L of plasma a day (GFR about 125 mL/min) and return over 99% of filtered water and sodium. They set urine volume and concentration under ADH, aldosterone and ANP.

entities.name: Ureters
entities.summary: Carry urine from each kidney to the bladder.

entities.name: Bladder
entities.summary: Stores urine. The viewer grows it with urine made since the last void and empties it at 0.4 L. That void rule is a display choice, not part of the model.

entities.name: Stomach
entities.summary: Receives drinks and food; gastric emptying gates delivery to the intestine. In the model, ingested water and salt sit in a single gut pool before absorption.

entities.name: Intestines
entities.summary: Absorb most ingested water and sodium. Plain water is absorbed with a half-time of minutes (deuterium tracer studies).

entities.name: Small intestine
entities.summary: Main site of absorption of ingested water and sodium.

entities.name: Liver
entities.summary: Secretes angiotensinogen, the substrate of renin. Included in V1 only for the renin-angiotensin pathway.

entities.name: Lung
entities.summary: Pulmonary endothelium is rich in angiotensin-converting enzyme, which converts angiotensin I to angiotensin II. Included in V1 only for that step.

entities.name: Posterior pituitary
entities.summary: Neurohypophysis. Axon terminals of hypothalamic magnocellular neurons release vasopressin (ADH) into blood as plasma osmolality rises. The marker pulses faster as simulated ADH rises.

entities.name: Hypothalamus
entities.summary: Contains the supraoptic and paraventricular nuclei, whose magnocellular neurons make vasopressin and project to the posterior pituitary.

entities.name: Adrenal glands
entities.summary: Sit on top of each kidney. The cortex secretes aldosterone, which raises sodium reabsorption when ECF volume falls.

entities.name: Brain
entities.summary: Generates thirst in response to rising osmolality or falling volume, via the lamina terminalis. Thirst is reported but does not trigger drinking in V1.

entities.name: Skin and interstitium
entities.summary: Stands in for the extracellular compartment; it tints as ECF volume changes. Skin sodium storage is reported but not modelled in V1.

entities.name: Skeletal muscle
entities.summary: Holds most intracellular fluid. Shown here as a stand-in for the ICF compartment; it tints as ICF volume changes.

entities.name: Cardiac atria
entities.summary: Upper heart chambers. Atrial myocytes release ANP when stretched by expanded blood volume.

entities.name: Supraoptic nucleus
entities.summary: Hypothalamic nucleus of magnocellular vasopressin and oxytocin neurons that project to the posterior pituitary.

entities.name: Paraventricular nucleus
entities.summary: Hypothalamic nucleus containing magnocellular vasopressin neurons (and parvocellular neurons not modelled in V1).

entities.name: OVLT
synonyms: organum vasculosum of the lamina terminalis
entities.summary: Organum vasculosum of the lamina terminalis: a circumventricular organ lacking a blood-brain barrier whose neurons sense plasma osmolality and drive vasopressin release and thirst.

entities.name: Subfornical organ
entities.summary: Circumventricular organ of the lamina terminalis that senses circulating angiotensin II and osmolality and drives thirst.

entities.name: Adrenal cortex
entities.summary: Outer steroid-producing part of the adrenal gland: zona glomerulosa (aldosterone), fasciculata (cortisol) and reticularis (androgens) in the standard zonation model.

entities.name: Zona glomerulosa
entities.summary: Outermost adrenal cortical zone; the textbook site of aldosterone synthesis, stimulated by angiotensin II and plasma potassium.

entities.name: Renal cortex
entities.summary: Outer kidney layer containing glomeruli, proximal and distal convoluted tubules and cortical collecting ducts.

entities.name: Renal medulla
entities.summary: Inner kidney region of loops of Henle and medullary collecting ducts; its hypertonic interstitium allows concentrated urine. Relatively hypoxic.

entities.name: Nephron
entities.summary: Functional unit of the kidney, roughly one million per kidney with wide individual variation: glomerulus, proximal tubule, loop of Henle, distal tubule and (functionally) collecting duct.

entities.name: Glomerulus
entities.summary: Capillary tuft where plasma is filtered into Bowman space through endothelium, basement membrane and podocyte slit diaphragms.

entities.name: Proximal tubule
entities.summary: First tubular segment; reabsorbs about two-thirds of filtered sodium and water isosmotically. Site of acute pressure natriuresis.

entities.name: Loop of Henle
entities.summary: Hairpin segment; the water-impermeable thick ascending limb reabsorbs NaCl via NKCC2, building the medullary osmotic gradient.

entities.name: Thick ascending limb
entities.summary: Water-impermeable segment that reabsorbs NaCl through NKCC2; target of loop diuretics.

entities.name: Distal tubule
entities.summary: Segment after the macula densa; the distal convoluted tubule reabsorbs NaCl through NCC (thiazide target).

entities.name: Distal convoluted tubule
entities.summary: Cortical segment reabsorbing NaCl via the thiazide-sensitive NCC.

entities.name: Collecting duct
entities.summary: Final segment where aldosterone (via ENaC) and vasopressin (via AQP2) fine-tune sodium and water excretion. Lined by principal and intercalated cells.

entities.name: Juxtaglomerular apparatus
entities.summary: Contact zone of the afferent arteriole, macula densa and extraglomerular mesangium; source of renin.

entities.name: Macula densa
entities.summary: Specialised thick-ascending-limb plaque that senses tubular NaCl and signals renin release and tubuloglomerular feedback.

entities.name: Principal cell (collecting duct)
entities.summary: Collecting-duct cell that reabsorbs sodium through ENaC and water through AQP2 channels. ADH inserts AQP2 into the apical membrane; aldosterone up-regulates ENaC.

entities.name: Intercalated cell
entities.summary: Collecting-duct and connecting-tubule cell type (A, B, non-A non-B) handling acid-base, chloride and potassium; interspersed among principal cells. Not modelled dynamically in V1.

entities.name: Podocyte
entities.summary: Glomerular visceral epithelial cell whose interdigitating foot processes and slit diaphragms form the final filtration barrier.

entities.name: Juxtaglomerular cell
entities.summary: Renin-secreting granular cell in the afferent arteriole wall; releases renin when perfusion pressure or distal NaCl delivery falls.

entities.name: Proximal tubule cell
entities.summary: Brush-border epithelial cell performing bulk isosmotic reabsorption of sodium, water, glucose and bicarbonate.

entities.name: Thick ascending limb cell
synonyms: kidney loop of Henle thick ascending limb epithelial cell
entities.summary: Epithelial cell of the thick ascending limb; apical NKCC2 and ROMK, basolateral Na-K-ATPase.

entities.name: Distal convoluted tubule cell
synonyms: kidney distal convoluted tubule epithelial cell
entities.summary: Epithelial cell reabsorbing NaCl via apical NCC.

entities.name: Macula densa cell
entities.summary: Senses luminal NaCl via NKCC2 and signals to the afferent arteriole and juxtaglomerular cells.

entities.name: Magnocellular vasopressin neuron
entities.summary: Hypothalamic neurosecretory neuron (supraoptic and paraventricular nuclei) that is intrinsically osmosensitive and releases vasopressin from posterior pituitary terminals.

entities.name: Zona glomerulosa cell
synonyms: type I cell of adrenal cortex
epithelial cell of zona glomerulosa of adrenal gland
entities.summary: Adrenocortical cell that, in the standard model, synthesises aldosterone via aldosterone synthase (CYP11B2) in response to angiotensin II and potassium.

entities.name: Atrial cardiomyocyte
entities.summary: Atrial muscle cell that stores and secretes ANP in response to wall stretch.

entities.name: Skeletal muscle fibre
entities.summary: Multinucleate muscle cell; collectively the largest intracellular water and potassium store.

entities.name: Apical membrane (principal cell)
entities.summary: Luminal plasma membrane of the principal cell; contains ENaC, ROMK and, under vasopressin, AQP2.

entities.name: Basolateral membrane (principal cell)
entities.summary: Blood-side membrane; carries the V2 receptor, Na-K-ATPase and the AQP3/AQP4 water exit channels.

entities.name: AQP2 storage vesicles
entities.summary: Intracellular vesicles holding AQP2; vasopressin triggers their fusion with the apical membrane, reversed on withdrawal.

entities.name: Nucleus (principal cell)
entities.summary: Site of mineralocorticoid-receptor gene transcription that raises ENaC activity over hours.

entities.name: Vasopressin neurosecretory vesicles
entities.summary: Dense-core vesicles in magnocellular axon terminals of the posterior pituitary that store and release vasopressin.

entities.name: Renin granules
entities.summary: Secretory granules of juxtaglomerular cells that store active renin.

entities.name: ADH → V2R → cAMP → AQP2
entities.summary: ADH binds the V2 receptor, Gs activates adenylyl cyclase, cAMP activates PKA, and PKA drives AQP2 vesicles to the apical membrane so water can be reabsorbed.

entities.name: Renin–angiotensin–aldosterone system
entities.summary: Renin from juxtaglomerular cells cleaves angiotensinogen to angiotensin I; ACE makes angiotensin II, which acts on AT1 receptors to constrict vessels, stimulate aldosterone and thirst, and retain sodium.

entities.name: Aldosterone → MR → ENaC
entities.summary: Aldosterone binds the mineralocorticoid receptor in principal cells; gene transcription raises apical ENaC and basolateral Na-K-ATPase activity, increasing sodium reabsorption and potassium secretion.

entities.name: ANP → NPR-A → cGMP
entities.summary: ANP binds NPR-A (guanylyl cyclase A), raising cGMP; effects include natriuresis, vasodilation and suppression of renin and aldosterone. Its weight in human salt-load natriuresis is disputed (see relations).

entities.name: Osmoreception
entities.summary: Detection of plasma osmolality by OVLT/SFO neurons and intrinsically osmosensitive magnocellular neurons; drives vasopressin release and thirst.

entities.name: Thirst
entities.summary: Conscious drive to drink, triggered by rising osmolality, falling volume and angiotensin II via the lamina terminalis. In V1 thirst is an output only.

entities.name: Pressure natriuresis
entities.summary: Rise in renal sodium excretion when renal perfusion pressure rises, largely by reduced proximal reabsorption; the long-term anchor of arterial pressure in Guyton-type models.

entities.name: Na-K-ATPase pump cycle
synonyms: sodium ion export across plasma membrane
entities.summary: ATP-driven export of 3 Na+ and import of 2 K+ per cycle; maintains the cell gradients that power tubular sodium reabsorption.

entities.name: Glomerular filtration
entities.summary: Ultrafiltration of plasma across the glomerular barrier; its rate (GFR) sets the filtered load of water and solutes.

entities.name: Tubular sodium reabsorption
entities.summary: Recovery of filtered sodium along the nephron, normally over 99% of the filtered load; proximal segments deliver a fairly constant load and distal segments match excretion to intake.

entities.name: Renin secretion
entities.summary: Release of renin from juxtaglomerular granules, stimulated by low perfusion pressure, low macula densa NaCl and sympathetic input.

entities.name: Aldosterone synthesis
entities.summary: Final steps of aldosterone production by aldosterone synthase (CYP11B2), stimulated by angiotensin II and potassium.

entities.name: Water
entities.summary: About 60% of body mass in the reference adult; distributed two-thirds intracellular, one-third extracellular, moving between them by osmosis.

entities.name: Sodium ion (Na+)
entities.summary: Main extracellular cation (plasma about 135–145 mmol/L); with its anions sets extracellular osmolality and hence ECF volume.

entities.name: Potassium ion (K+)
entities.summary: Main intracellular cation; kept inside cells by the Na-K-ATPase. Plasma K is not modelled in V1.

entities.name: Chloride ion (Cl-)
entities.summary: Main extracellular anion, co-transported with sodium by NKCC2 and NCC.

entities.name: Urea
entities.summary: Nitrogen waste solute; contributes to plasma osmolality but crosses cell membranes, so it does not shift water between ECF and ICF. Held constant in V1.

entities.name: Glucose
entities.summary: Plasma fuel; enters plasma osmolality as glucose(mg/dL)/18. Held constant in V1.

entities.name: Vasopressin (ADH)
entities.summary: Nine-residue peptide hormone (CYFQNCPRG) with a disulfide bond between the two cysteines. Released from the posterior pituitary as plasma osmolality rises; plasma half-life about 24 minutes.

entities.name: Aldosterone
entities.summary: Mineralocorticoid steroid that increases distal sodium reabsorption and potassium secretion via the mineralocorticoid receptor; rises when salt intake falls.

entities.name: Atrial natriuretic peptide (ANP)
entities.summary: Peptide hormone released by stretched atria; acts on NPR-A. Plasma half-life about 2.5–3 minutes in humans.

entities.name: Angiotensinogen
entities.summary: Liver-secreted plasma protein; renin cleaves it to angiotensin I.

entities.name: Angiotensin I
entities.summary: Decapeptide cut from angiotensinogen by renin; largely inactive until converted by ACE.

entities.name: Angiotensin II
entities.summary: Octapeptide (human sequence Ile5) and the main active RAAS product; via AT1 receptors it constricts arterioles, stimulates aldosterone and thirst, and increases proximal sodium reabsorption.

entities.name: Renin
entities.summary: Aspartyl protease secreted by juxtaglomerular cells; the rate-limiting step of the RAAS.

entities.name: Angiotensin-converting enzyme (ACE)
entities.summary: Endothelial peptidase (abundant in lung) converting angiotensin I to angiotensin II.

entities.name: cAMP
entities.summary: Second messenger made by adenylyl cyclase after V2 receptor activation; activates PKA.

entities.name: cGMP
entities.summary: Second messenger synthesised by NPR-A when ANP binds.

entities.name: ATP
entities.summary: Energy currency hydrolysed by the Na-K-ATPase; renal sodium transport is a major consumer of renal oxygen.

entities.name: Aquaporin-2 (AQP2)
entities.summary: Vasopressin-regulated water channel of collecting-duct principal cells, shuttled between storage vesicles and the apical membrane.

entities.name: Aquaporin-3 (AQP3)
entities.summary: Basolateral water exit channel of principal cells (with AQP4).

entities.name: Epithelial sodium channel (ENaC)
entities.summary: Apical, amiloride-sensitive sodium channel of alpha, beta and gamma subunits; up-regulated by aldosterone.

entities.name: Na-K-ATPase
entities.summary: Basolateral sodium pump (alpha1/beta1 is the renal isoform pair) exchanging 3 Na+ out for 2 K+ in per ATP.

entities.name: NKCC2
entities.summary: Apical Na-K-2Cl cotransporter of the thick ascending limb and macula densa; target of loop diuretics.

entities.name: NCC
entities.summary: Apical thiazide-sensitive Na-Cl cotransporter of the distal convoluted tubule.

entities.name: Vasopressin V2 receptor
entities.summary: Gs-coupled receptor on the basolateral membrane of principal cells.

entities.name: Angiotensin II type 1 receptor
entities.summary: G-protein-coupled receptor mediating most known angiotensin II actions.

entities.name: Mineralocorticoid receptor
entities.summary: Nuclear receptor activated by aldosterone; drives transcription that increases ENaC activity.

entities.name: NPR-A (guanylyl cyclase A)
entities.summary: Transmembrane guanylyl cyclase receptor for ANP and BNP.

entities.name: Gs alpha subunit
entities.summary: Stimulatory G-protein alpha subunit coupling the V2 receptor to adenylyl cyclase.

entities.name: Adenylyl cyclase 6
entities.summary: Adenylyl cyclase isoform producing cAMP downstream of the V2 receptor in principal cells.

entities.name: Protein kinase A (catalytic alpha)
entities.summary: cAMP-activated kinase that phosphorylates AQP2 and promotes its apical insertion.

entities.name: ROMK
entities.summary: Renal outer medullary potassium channel; apical potassium secretion pathway of principal cells and recycling channel in the thick ascending limb.

entities.name: Aldosterone synthase (CYP11B2)
entities.summary: Mitochondrial cytochrome P450 catalysing the final steps of aldosterone synthesis.
